about: Raw replies of this export and the message each must parse to. response_check.py holds transformers' parse_response (the response template in response_template.json) to `expected`; scripts/ortllama-gate.mjs holds slicc-ortllama's own parser to the same messages. `raw` is the decoded reply with special tokens kept, plus </s> when the model stopped. Cases with "round_trip": false parse to a message that renders back without the reply's stray whitespace.
